messages:
Amira (CSM): Heads-up — EBR for AtlasOps in 3 days. Need exec slide + renewal risk slide + enablement ask. Can folks confirm owners?

Matt (CSM): I can own slides 1–3 (account health + usage trends). Will add renewal risk slide if any flags. Anyone have recent NPS/CSAT to drop in?

Jordan (PE): I'll take perf/infra summary. Adding 95/99th latency charts and recent deploy impact notes. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Lina (Enablement): I'll draft the enablement ask + one‑pager playbook. Need a customer contact to confirm demo scope.

Amira (CSM): Customer exec sponsor is Sara M. Lina, can you DM Sara to confirm availability? Also who owns onboarding integrations status?

Matt (CSM): Onboarding integrations status: doc updated here: https://redwood.internal/notes/atlasops-onboard (internal). Current: 2/5 integrations complete, 1 blocked on API keys.

Jordan (PE): Risk notes to include: SSO mapping delays and data-plane cert renewal window. Added to my slide notes.

Ops Bot: ops-bot: Reminder: deck upload deadline in 48h. Use path: /slides/EBR_AtlasOps_v1.pptx.

Amira (CSM): Action items recap: Matt — slides + renewal slide; Jordan — perf + infra; Lina — enablement ask + schedule playbook demo; Amira — exec brief + outcomes. Dry-run Thurs 10:00 PT. :calendar:

Sara M (Exec Sponsor): Sara M: Confirmed — Thurs 11:00 PT works for exec dry-run on my side. I'll bring two customer success anecdotes to highlight ROI.

Lina (Enablement): :thumbsup: I'll prepare a 15-min demo and a one-pager playbook for the execs.

Matt (CSM): I'll include token-level cost breakdown and a short forecast slide. Ping me for raw numbers if needed.

Amira (CSM): One more ask — capture feedback from last month’s POE. Jordan, can you pull top 3 regressions to call out?

Jordan (PE): On it. Draft bullets for slide notes: - prompt timeout spike on long-context runs - embedding drift vs vendor dataset in March - tokenization mismatch on non-UTF8 filenames.

Amira (CSM): Perfect. I’ll assemble v0 and post by 09:00 PT Thursday for comments. If anyone can’t make the dry-run, please record notes or leave comments in the deck. Thanks team :rocket:
